question: Which of the following countries won the highest gold medals in Tokyo Olympics 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is **__United States of America__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The country finished the Games with 113 medals, the most amongst all nations:** 39 gold, 41 silver, and 33 bronze**. These individual totals were each the highest of the Games, after a final-day tally of three gold medals (women's basketball, women's omnium, and women's volleyball) surpassed **China's **total of 38 golds.
 
• Overall, the medal total was slightly lower than **five year prior **in **Rio de Janeiro** , where the **United States won 46 gold and 121 total medals.**
 
• Total Americans are there in** Tokyo 2020 were 613.**
 
• The **Olympic Games **are an international sports festival, held every four years**. The ultimate goals are to cultivate human beings, through sport, and contribute to world peace. Summer Games and Winter Games are held separately.

​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Japan** won **18 medals** at the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics, greatly surpassing its previous record total of 13 at** Pyeongchang **in 2018.
 
• Australia competed at the 2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo. **Originally scheduled to take place from 24 July to 9 August 2020, the Games were postponed to 23 July to 8 August 2021, because of the COVID-19 pandemic**.
 
• China wins its first gold of the Games in a new mixed-gender short-track event. With a flash of a skate, **China won its first medal of the Beijing Winter Olympics on Saturday**, which was also the first gold medal in a new Olympic event the short-track speedskating mixed-gender team relay.
